title: 2014 AMC 10A Problem 15
statement: David drives from his home to the airport to catch a flight. He drives \(35\) miles in the first hour, but realizes that he will be \(1\) hour late if he continues at this speed. He increases his speed by \(15\) miles per hour for the rest of the way to the airport and arrives \(30\) minutes early. How many miles is the airport from his home?

solutions.text:
Note that David drives at \(50\) miles per hour after one hour.

Then, if the airport is \(x\) miles from David’s house, we know that: \[\dfrac x{35} - \left(1+\dfrac{x-35}{50}\right) = \dfrac 32\] We solve this equation as follows: \[\begin{aligned} \dfrac x{35} - \left(1+\dfrac{x-35}{50}\right) &= \dfrac 32\\ \dfrac x{35} - \dfrac{x-35+50}{50} &= \dfrac 32\\ 10x - 7(x+15)&= 525\\ 10x - 7x-105&= 525\\ 3x&= 630\\ x&=210 \end{aligned}\] Therefore, the airport is \(x=210\) miles from David’s house.

Thus, C is the correct answer.
hints: Compare the original too-slow schedule with the faster schedule
The faster trip saves \(1.5\) hours overall
